audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 4/10, carryRating 5/10 and 'Favoured matchup' on a 38.89% lane whose own prose says Sett owns levels 3 through first item. The level chart also disagreed with the packet chart on six of seven rows.
audit.why: Every why/spike in the content layer describes Sett winning from Facebreaker onward; the packet chart is Neeko/Skill/Sett/Sett/Sett/Sett/Skill and matches that prose.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet order in both layers, difficulty raised to 7/10 and carry threat to 7/10, 'Favoured' replaced with 'Hard'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was described as an interrupted channel and Sett's first-item spike as generic 'Bami's/bruiser'.
audit.why: The Show Stopper carries the target through the air and slams them — a displacement with grounding, not a channel interrupt on a cast; and Haymaker banks damage taken as Grit into a shield, so his spike is the stored shield, not an item stat.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now states The Show Stopper carries you out of Pop Blossom's wind-up; the item spike names the banked Grit shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: R called a 'suppress' and named 'The Show'; Neeko's W credited with invisibility; Haymaker's shield never mentioned as the reason her burst fails.
audit.why: Riot text: R is The Show Stopper, a carry-and-slam with grounding; W Haymaker spends stored Grit for a shield plus true damage in the centre; E Facebreaker is a 490-range pull that stuns only when enemies are on both sides, otherwise slows. Neeko's Shapesplitter is a directional clone with a third-attack proc — no invisibility.
audit.corrected: Real names and mechanics used; the Grit shield is now stated as the thing that eats her burst; the invisibility claim removed. Also matches missingInteractions: dash-denied (R vs Pop Blossom) and shield-absorbs-burst.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Use Shapesplitter' — Shapesplitter is Neeko's real W name, false positive. The genuine error in that line was 'invisibility'.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are Sett's lane to take. He has the grit to facetank your Q poke and heal through it while his stored Haymaker (W) punishes every trade you start, and at 6 you simply cannot win the all-in: his E-grab into W true-damage smash into The Show (R) suppress will interrupt your Pop Blossom (R) channel and delete you before the slam ever lands. Do not try to out-combo him here — use Shapesplitter (W) clone-and-invisibility to dodge the Facebreaker grab, shove with Q, and roam to a lane where your root actually lands.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are Sett's lane to take. His missing-health regen carries him through your Q poke and every point of it banks Grit, so the Haymaker shield eats the burst you already paid for. At 6 you cannot win the all-in: Facebreaker pull-stuns at 490, Haymaker lands true damage down the centre, and The Show Stopper grounds and carries you clean out of Pop Blossom's wind-up. Do not out-combo him here — send the Shapesplitter (W) clone in to bait the grab, shove with Q, and roam to a lane where your root lands.
